task_name: Reposition Small Fountain Park Behind Skyscraper Cluster for Maximum Population Boost

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: After the skyscraper ('El Dorado Tower') finishes construction (+439 base population) and displays a green thought bubble saying 'We're stressed out! We need parks!'.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Moving the Small Fountain Park from the low-density right side of the street to the road directly behind the new skyscraper and adjacent apartment towers covers the highest-density buildings in the city, nearly tripling the park's boost to +94 population.
preconditions: High-density skyscraper and apartment cluster built
Existing Small Fountain Park available to move for free
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Drag the Small Fountain Park onto the parallel road directly behind the skyscraper cluster so its green coverage area overlaps all four tall residential buildings.

steps.who: green speech bubble on El Dorado Tower
steps.briefing: read the citizen feedback requesting parks near the skyscraper.

steps.who: Small Fountain Park (tap and hold to pick up)
steps.briefing: drag the Small Fountain Park to the road directly behind El Dorado Tower and the adjacent apartments (+94 population boost).
